body:
Possibly my new favourite benzodiazepine?
I started off my morning on an empty stomach, at around 9AMish, I then popped x2 10mg Temazepam (TEMTABS) tablets with a slight preexisting benzodiazepine tolerance. I then did some chores whilst I waited for the Tems to kick in.
Once I finished my chores at around 10AM, I sat down at my computer and I felt the Tems starting to kick in so I then proceeded to smoke several bongs of weed and that definitely accelerated the intensity of the come up and eventually the peak.
30/45 mins later, and I feel really blissful, chillaxed and sensual. I feel really content with myself and euphoric in general. Not sure how else to put it but I feel really wonderful. I can feel the soft fabrics of my clothing rub against my skin and it feels really nice, the hair running down my face feels silky smooth and relaxing. Everything feels blissfully content.
The higher I get from the Tems along with the combination of the weed, I start to feel increasingly horny as well which is interesting, but I am not complaining.
This seems to be the only benzodiazepine medication I have taken where my libido actually increases rather than decreases, like with other benzodiazepine medication I have taken such as Diazepam, Clonazepam, Alprazolam etc.
A little over an hour since consumption, I'm contemplating taking another 10mg tablet to increase the effects, but at the same time I don't want to pass out lol! If I end up taking the extra 10mg, I can expect the effects I already have to be much more enhanced. But I currently feel really blissful, euphoric, extremely relaxed, content and surprisingly not feeling tired or lethargic as Temazepam is generally prescribed for insomnia. Not to mention the munchies! I am mad hungry right now! So I'm gonna fix myself a massive feed after this.
In conclusion; Temazepam for me personally seems like a great recreational benzodiazepine. Temazepam sort of feels like a Clonazepam-Valium hybrid, and maybe even close to a low dose of alprazolam but with increasingly more euphoria and it pairs great with cannabis, just like any other benzodiazepine :).
Good stuff, thanks for reading <3.
Important side-note: I currently suffer from Severe GAD(Generalized Anxiety Disorder).
